[CnC2Pyrr][BMPB] and [CnC6Pyrr][BMDP] are the most promising additives to PEG.
[CnC12Pyrr][BMD] 4 and [CnC10Pyrr][BDM] 4 are the most promising lubricant additives in polyethylene oxide.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of hf BMLs in PEG improves its lubricating properties and this effect is more significant for ionic liquids with short alkyl chains.
the lubricating performance of the ionic liquid additives in PEG is strongly affected by the length and nature of alkyl chains in cations.
the addition of hf BIL to PEG improves lubricity and antiwear properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hf BIL [CnCnPyrr][Bmb] with a short alkyl chain (n 5) is an excellent lubricant additive to PEG.
the lubrication performance of hf BIL additives in PEG can be tuned by changing the structure of cations and the anion.
the hf BILs can be used as effective antiwear and friction reducing lubricant additives in PEG.
